text:
Predicates:
InCity(x) ::: x is in a city.
InState(x, y) ::: x is in state y.
City(x) ::: x is a city.
State(x) ::: x is a state.
InCityOf(x, y) ::: x is in city y.
DifferentStates(x, y) ::: x and y are in different states.
OnlyInOneState(x, y) ::: city x is only in one state y.
Premises:
City(Billings) ∧ InState(Billings, Montana) ::: Billings is a city in Montana.
State(Montana) ∧ City(Butte) ∧ City(Helena) ∧ City(Missoula) ::: Montana includes Butte, Helena, and Missoula.
City(WhiteSulphurSprings) ∧ City(Butte) ∧ InState(WhiteSulphurSprings, Montana) ::: White Sulphur Springs and Butte are in the same state, Montana.
City(StPierre) ∧ ¬InState(StPierre, Montana) ::: St Pierre is not in Montana.
∀x (InCityOf(x, Butte) → ¬InCityOf(x, StPierre)) ::: Any city in Butte is not in St Pierre.
∀x (InCityOf(x, y) ∧ InCityOf(x, z) → y = z) ::: A city can only be in one state unless specified otherwise.
Conclusion:
DifferentStates(StPierre, Bismarck) ::: St Pierre and Bismarck are in different states.
